$comment: The pin for the hafs-kfqc page corpus. 348 MB of upstream SVG is too large to vendor under packages/etl/data/ the way the mutashabihat, roots and tajweed inputs are, so this file stands in for the input: a SHA-256 for every upstream file, and one for every byte vendor-pages.mjs writes. `upstream`/`meta` are checked when re-vendoring (they prove the fetch got what was pinned); `vendored` is checked offline by gate:pages on every CI run (it proves the committed page SVGs were produced by this recipe and not hand-edited). Regenerate only with `vendor:pages --repin`, deliberately, reviewing the diff.
license: See docs/SOURCES.md — the KFGQPC QCF V2 glyph outlines are the King Fahd Complex's; quran-svg packages them.
print: KFGQPC QCF V2 / 1421H (NOT V1/1405H) — see PROVENANCE.md for the evidence and the consequence for cross-check sources.

svgo.$comment: Not a taste call. This exact config was recovered by searching plugin-disable masks against apps/web/public/assets/pages/hafs-kfqc/7.svg — the page Loop 0 vendored by hand — and it reproduces all three Loop 0 pages byte-for-byte. collapseGroups flattens the outer transform matrix the stage's coordinate model assumes; removeUnknownsAndDefaults strips the number/surah/ayah attributes the resolver reads; cleanupIds renames verse-*, which is the anchor itself.
